name: fog-overview
description: Overview button for players and the GM; galaxy names on the switch buttons. Assumes the default (not split) map refresh style.

steps.note: you = sol (carrier at 305: alpha wormhole to a000, hyperlane 306, custom hyperlane 204); seat1 = hacan (destroyer at a301, hyperlane 207 next to its home).

steps.label: Sol's map offers the green Overview button
In the shared channel the overview is a private reply
The switch button carries the galaxy name
Hacan's map offers its own Overview
The GM map offers the GM Overview

steps.note: By hand: Sol's overview shows only Sol's known systems (incl. hyperlane 306 and custom lane 204); the GM overview shows every panel with hyperlanes 306/207/a105 and custom lanes 204/a206; Hacan's overview shows nothing of Sol's area.
